map.可逆过程熵变：ΔS = Q ÷ T（J/K）；联动卡：1/T 卡按 ΔS ÷ Q: Reversible-process entropy change: ΔS = Q ÷ T (J/K); linked cards: the 1/T card is recomputed as ΔS ÷ Q (1/K), heat recomputed Q = T×ΔS (J), 1/ΔS = 1 ÷ (ΔS||1) (K/J, falling back to 1 when ΔS = 0). Validation: non-empty valid-numeric guards for Q and T; when T = 0 the division falls back to «—». Criteria: no fixed grading; ΔS has the same sign as Q and is inversely proportional to T.
